prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant's account changed in important ways between conversations: the direction of the impact and the number of people in the car are now different.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a busy road in Baytown, Texas, when another car came alongside me and clipped the side of my vehicle. I pulled over as soon as I could and checked the damage, which was mostly along the passenger side panels. I have been asked about the event more than once, and I want to be upfront that when I first described what happened I said the other car struck me from the left, but on reflection I believe it came from the right, and I also said there were two people with me when I was in fact alone. I was the named driver on this policy at the time. The main injury I have is a strain in my lower back, which I first noticed later that evening and which has limited my movement since. I have kept my medical notes and repair estimates and am glad to provide them.
